meta.name: exa-search
meta.description: Web toolkit powered by Exa, tuned for scientific and technical content. Use this skill when the user needs to search the web or fetch/extract URL content. Covers: web search (semantic lookups, research, current info — with optional research-paper category and academic domain filtering) and URL extraction (fetching pages, articles, academic PDFs in batch). Use this skill for web-related tasks when the user wants high-quality search or scholarly filtering via category=research paper. Triggers on requests to search, look up, fetch a page, or extract an article.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索网页并提取链接内容,快速获取技术资料
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在研究或开发中快速获取网页和论文内容。
copy.tagline_en: Search the web and extract page content to get technical info
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly gather web pages and papers for work or study.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能调用 Exa 搜索引擎做网页搜索(可偏向学术论文、限定学术域名),也能批量抓取指定网址的内容(网页、文章、学术 PDF),并按要求优先引用学术来源。
howto.when: 当用户请求搜索、查资料、获取某个网址或提取文章内容时触发;特别是需要科学/学术类搜索时。

say.text: 搜索关于量子计算的学术论文
say.note: 触发带 research paper 类别的语义搜索。

say.text: 在 arxiv.org 上找最新的扩散模型论文

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can run Exa-powered web searches (optionally biased toward research papers or restricted to academic domains) and batch-extract content from URLs (webpages, articles, academic PDFs), prioritizing scholarly sources when relevant.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to search the web, look something up, fetch a page, or extract an article, especially for scientific/technical or scholarly queries.

say_en.text: Search for academic papers on quantum computing.
say_en.note: Triggers semantic search with research paper category.

say_en.text: Fetch and summarize this page: https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.00001
say_en.note: Calls URL extraction to return the page content.

say_en.text: Find recent diffusion model papers on arxiv.org
say_en.note: Restricts search to an academic domain allowlist.
